text:
The hardest part of integrating AI into product management isn’t the technology; it’s managing the people and processes that surround it. 

Reflecting on my transition into AI product management, I’m struck by how critical it is to foster a culture of collaboration and understanding. At CoachHub, I led a tribe of 35 across multiple squads, emphasizing the importance of shared ownership in our AI initiatives. When we redesigned our onboarding process from 15 to just 4 steps, it wasn’t just about efficiency; it was about creating a smoother experience for our coachees — a people-first approach that drove engagement.

As I pursue AI consulting roles, I see that the gap between having AI and knowing how to use it effectively is substantial. Success in these roles will hinge on our ability to bridge that gap through strong interpersonal skills, fostering open dialogue, and cultivating diverse teams. It’s essential we create environments where people feel safe experimenting and questioning.

How are you building understanding and trust around AI in your teams?
